title: Define Cloud Migration Table Mappings in Business Central

facts.text: Table mapping allows renaming tables during cloud migration or moving subset of fields to table extension.
Multiple source tables cannot map to same destination table; each destination requires single on-premises source table.
Keys in on-premises and online tables must match; online target table must have ReplicateData property set to true.
Open Migration Table Mapping from Cloud Migration Management, set Target Table Type to Table or Table Extension, fill source and target table names.
Source table names entered as SQL format: C/AL example [CRONUS COMPANY$Table Name], AL example with GUID.
Table extension mapping only supported for Business Central cloud migrations; Dynamics GP and SL do not support table extensions.
Subscribe to OnInsertDefaultTableMappings event from codeunit 4001 Hybrid Cloud Management to provide table mappings programmatically.
